After 60 years of experience, CDD is specialised in the supply of duty free, tax-free and luxury goods directly to diplomats, the military, wholesale customers and to the general public through our network of airport stores. 

*Chacalli-De Decker is Europe’s leading supplier to the diplomatic community, serving over 20.000 diplomatic personnel at embassies around the world.

*Since 1954, Chacalli-De Decker has supplied many military organisations operating around the world, including SHAPE, NATO, the UN and OPCW.

*Chacalli-De Decker’s wholesale service for key account customers, such as airlines and ship chandlers, is fast, reliable and efficient.

*Through Chacalli-De Decker’s network of stores at regional airports, the company works hard to offer travelers premium brands and exclusive products at fantastic prices.

CDD does not just ‘provide products’ but is dedicated in continuously improving its expertise, efficiency and service level in order to develop excellent and durable client relations. In the past 60 years CDD has also built an extensive network of suppliers and brand owners, enabling it to offer almost all the international brands, against highly competitive prices and directly out of its own stock.

Since October 2013 CDD Holding BV has become part of the Flemingo group, the fastest growing company in the international duty free business. Being part of a large global growing and ambitious company, CDD knows its customers will also benefit.
